setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with an admin profile and a seller profile (a role without WorkOrder permissions). A project <project> of tasks with Monday–Friday working days, a holiday and open tasks with dates, linked to a work order <work order> in no stage; a deal <deal> with no work order. Every notice these cases trigger must go to the tester.

evals.prompt: Crea un proyecto de implementación llamado <new project> con estas tareas, todas para mí: kickoff el <day> (1 día), configuración de la cuenta después (3 días hábiles) y capacitación al final (1 día). No trabajamos sábados ni domingos y el <holiday> es festivo. Estoy en Bogotá.
evals.expected_output: Previews a project plan with offset -05:00, Monday–Friday plus the holiday, three chained tasks with dates that skip the weekend and the holiday, stops; after the yes applies and reports the GRP and TSK codes.
expectations: Uses scripts/projects.js preview with kind project, offset -05:00 and the tasks chained with "after"
Shows the dates per task in local time and that the holiday and weekend are skipped
Writes nothing before the yes; after it, apply with --version and --confirmed
Reports the project id/code and the three tasks; answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: ¿Cómo va el proyecto <project>? ¿Qué tareas están vencidas y de quién son?
evals.expected_output: Runs find and status (read only) and summarises totals, completion, overdue tasks with days late and owner, without writing.
expectations: Runs scripts/projects.js find and status; no writes
Lists overdue open tasks with their owner and days late, and says done tasks are not counted

evals.prompt: Se corrió el arranque: reprograma las tareas pendientes de <project> para que empiecen el <new start>.
evals.expected_output: Previews a reschedule with newStart and the project's offset, shows how many working days and the before/after dates, says done tasks stay and nobody is notified, stops; after the yes applies and reports moved counts.
expectations: Uses a reschedule plan through the script, never hand-made PATCHes
Asks for or states the time zone offset; shows before and after dates
Writes only after the yes and reports how many tasks moved

evals.prompt: Crea la orden de trabajo para el negocio <deal> y pásala a ejecución.
evals.expected_output: Previews a workorder plan (deal read only, contact from the deal, no stage), stops; after the yes creates it, then previews the move to In execution with prolibu-stages and asks again before moving.
expectations: Creates the work order with projects.js (kind workorder), never with createFromDeal or by editing the deal
Does not set the stage in the create; uses prolibu-stages move for In execution with its own preview
Reports the WO code and, after the move, the recorded start time

evals.prompt: Comparte el cronograma de <project> con el cliente por un link público.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the skill does not turn public sharing on: the link needs no sign-in, stays the same if sharing is turned on again and exposes members' names and e-mails; offers alternatives and writes nothing.
expectations: Writes nothing and does not PATCH shareTimeline
Explains the exposure (no sign-in, members' e-mails, link cannot be changed)
Leaves the decision to the user in the app; answers in Spanish
